title: 第22章 秋梧第23章 危机
lines: 几个身着软甲的大汉正围在一桌喝酒，开口之人正是其中一名最为雄壮的男子
见二人望来，他也是连忙举杯
"没有冒犯两位的意思，只是很久没有见到如此可爱的小姑娘了"
周雪闻言也是轻哼一声看着周岐，然后壮汉又摇了摇头叹息道
"可惜这里没有以前那么平静了，二位还是尽量远离皇城或者太过喧嚣之地吧"
这时小二上来看周岐他们在讨论立马放好东西便离开，周雪还想说说什么
周岐抬手暗示周雪不用回应，壮汉看他们不说话也转过身去
"大叔，你干嘛，刚好可以打听一下这里呀"
"不急，等会我们去鬼市，那可是整个众生天消息最多最全的地方了"
"大叔来过这里吗？"
"没吃过猪肉还能没见过猪跑吗"
周雪也是白了他一眼
随着夜色的降临，人影也越发稀少，周岐他们也是离开酒楼向深处走去，夜晚的街道无比寂静，没有一丝人影
"大叔怎么没人啊"
就在二人走到一座断桥处，周岐伸手一点，断桥前方突然出现一个半人高的虚空通道，二人踏了进去
里面很简陋，但是很喧嚣甚至是混乱，一座十分庞大的圆台，圆台之上矗立着一座金塔，圆台其余的空地上全是人影，圆台周围还有三座山峰大小的光门，不断有人进入光门，也有人席地摆摊
"好东西啊，至祖飞升丹，一颗吃了直接成祖尊"
"哥们真的假的？！"
"你说呢！爱买不买，只收法髓啊，机不可失，失不再来"
"拍卖会插队卡，全是好位置，有人要不"
"神功秘籍，只卖有缘人"
周雪看着这里还是头一次见到这么多人
"大叔，从进入众生天我就感觉真成凡人了，这里这么混乱，进去不会被踩死吧"
周岐没有回答她，随即带着她慢步向前穿过人群走向圆台
"整个众生天是道弃之地，这里法源，血脉，神识都不能动用，哪怕肉身也不行，这里唯一能用的只有意"
"法源是修士的根本，法意便是修道的根本，踏入修行的修士自然是领悟了自己的道，自己的法源的
而提升法源就要去悟道，去悟意，意越深，不仅是修为会提升，你的法也会更强"
周雪似懂非懂的点了点头，好不容易挤过人群，圆台上的三座光门下分别有
"交易"、"血斗"、"占卜"
周岐二人上去交了两枚道晶便进入了占卜光门之中
光门里面很安静，非常安静，只有一座露天楼阁，里面红毯铺地，五个蒙头的黑衣人盘坐在地
周岐他们进来才发现不知何时，他们也是蒙着头，不过隐隐约约可以看得见，不是很厚
"都坐下一个一个问吧"一道苍老的声音不知在何处响起
周岐二人也是席地而坐，只见其中一道人影动了动，突然天上落下一枚玉简，人影起身在桌上放了一枚储物戒指离去
前面几人同样如此，就在马上到周雪时，一道人影突然疯狂蠕动似乎被束缚一般，动作也越来越大，突然那人的头套被甩飞
"大叔，是那个老大叔"周雪眯着眼似乎看清了人影真是酒楼与他们相聊的男子
只见壮汉似乎死死瞪着深处，身上的气息在不断消失
"大叔救救他吧"周雪隔着头套望向身后的周岐
周岐眼睛一眯似乎在思考，片刻后只见从他身上突然散发出一圈圈光晕，随即立马散向四周
整个楼阁直接炸开，一道闷哼之声在深处响起
content_en:
Several big men in soft armor were drinking at a table, and the person who spoke was one of the most majestic men among them.
Seeing the two of them looking at each other, he also quickly raised his glass.
"No offense to you two, it's just that I haven't seen such a cute little girl for a long time."
When Zhou Xue heard this, she also snorted and looked at Zhou Qi. Then the strong man shook his head and sighed.
"It's a pity that this place is not as peaceful as before. You two should try to stay away from the imperial city or too noisy places."
At this time, the waiter came up to see Zhou Qi and the others discussing and immediately put away their things and left. What else did Zhou Xue want to say?
Zhou Qi raised his hand to indicate that Zhou Xue didn't need to respond. The strong man turned around when they didn't speak.
"Uncle, what are you doing? You can just inquire about this place."
"Don't worry, we'll go to the ghost market later. That's the place with the most information and the most complete information on all sentient beings."
"Has uncle been here?"
"How can you never see a pig running if you haven't eaten pork?"
Zhou Xue also rolled her eyes at him.
As night fell, the number of people became increasingly rare. Zhou Qi and the others also left the restaurant and walked deeper. The streets at night were extremely quiet, without a trace of people.
"Uncle, why is there no one?"
"…"
Just when the two of them reached a broken bridge, Zhou Qi stretched out his hand, and a half-person-high void passage suddenly appeared in front of the broken bridge, and the two of them stepped into it.
The inside is very simple, but very noisy and even chaotic. There is a very large round platform, and a golden pagoda stands on top of the round platform. The rest of the open space on the round platform is full of people. There are three light gates the size of mountain peaks around the round platform. People are constantly entering the light gate, and some are sitting on the ground setting up stalls.
"What a good thing. The Supreme Ancestral Ascension Pill. If you eat one pill, you will become the ancestor."
"Dude, is this really fake?!"
"What do you think? Do you want to buy it or not? I only collect the essence of the Dharma. Don't miss this opportunity. If you lose it, it will never come back."
"Queue-jumping cards in the auction. They are all in good positions. Anyone wants to do it?"
"Secrets of magic skills are only sold to those who are destined to be"
Zhou Xue looked at this place and saw so many people for the first time.
"Uncle, I feel like a mortal since I entered the Heaven of All Living Beings. This place is so chaotic. I won't be trampled to death if I go in."
Zhou Qi didn't answer her, and then led her slowly forward through the crowd towards the round platform.
"The entire heaven of sentient beings is a place where Tao is abandoned. The source of law, blood, and spiritual consciousness cannot be used here, not even the physical body. The only thing that can be used here is the mind."
"Meaning?"
"The source of the Dharma is the foundation of a monk, and the intention of the Dharma is the foundation of the practice. A monk who steps into practice will naturally understand his own way and his own source of the law.
To improve the source of the Dharma, you need to understand the Tao and the meaning. The deeper the meaning, not only will your cultivation level improve, but your Dharma will also be stronger."
Zhou Xue nodded in understanding, and finally squeezed through the crowd. Under the three light doors on the round platform, there were
"Trading", "Blood Fight", "Divination"
Zhou Qi and the others went up and handed over two Dao Crystals and entered the divination light gate.
It was very quiet inside Guangmen, very quiet. There was only an open-air pavilion with a red carpet on the floor and five hooded men in black sitting cross-legged on the ground.
When Zhou Qi and the others came in, they discovered that at some point, they were also covering their heads, but they could vaguely see it, and it was not very thick.
"Sit down and ask one by one." An old voice sounded from somewhere.
Zhou Qi and Zhou Qi were also sitting on the floor. They saw one of the figures move. Suddenly a jade slip fell from the sky. The figure got up, put a storage ring on the table and left.
The same was true for the previous people. Just as they were about to reach Zhou Xue, a figure suddenly squirmed crazily as if it was being restrained. The movements became larger and larger, and suddenly the man's hood was thrown away.
"Uncle, it's that old uncle." Zhou Xue squinted and seemed to see clearly that the figure was actually the man they were chatting with in the restaurant.
I saw that the strong man seemed to be staring into the depths, and the breath on his body was disappearing.
"Uncle, please save him." Zhou Xue looked at Zhou Qi behind her through her hood.
Zhou Qi narrowed his eyes and seemed to be thinking. After a moment, he saw circles of light suddenly emanating from his body, and then immediately dispersed around him.
"Bang"
The entire pavilion exploded directly, and a muffled sound sounded in the depths.
